fields.label: Accrued interest
fields.definition: Interest accrued per 100 of face from the last coupon date to the settlement date, on the issue’s day-count convention.
fields.derivation: coupon × dayCountFraction(lastCoupon, settle) on the issue convention

fields.label: Accrued days
fields.definition: Number of days of interest accrued from the last coupon date to the settlement date, counted on the issue’s day-count convention — the numerator of the accrual fraction.
fields.derivation: dayCount.days(lastCouponDate, settlementDate) on the issue convention

fields.label: Price adjustment factor
fields.definition: Cumulative factor applied to the unadjusted close of a session to put it on the basis of the last bar of the window: the product of every split and, under the total-return policy, every dividend factor with an ex-date after that session. 1.0 when no action follows.
fields.derivation: Π over later actions of (ratioOld/ratioNew) for splits and (1 − amount/closeBeforeEx) for dividends, where closeBeforeEx is the unadjusted close of the session before the ex-date

example.ref: TESTING §7.9 case 1 (2:1 split + 0.50 dividend on a 50.00 close)

fields.label: Volume adjustment factor
fields.definition: Cumulative factor applied to the unadjusted volume of a session so that share counts are comparable across splits. It is the reciprocal of the split part of ADJ_FACTOR_PX; cash dividends never move it.
fields.derivation: Π over later splits of (ratioNew/ratioOld)

fields.label: Adjustment policy
fields.definition: Which corporate-action adjustment produced the series on the screen: unadjusted (raw tape), price (splits only) or total_return (splits and dividends reinvested). Published with every adjusted series, because two policies give two different numbers for the same day.
fields.derivation: the AdjustPolicy the run was asked for; echoed, never inferred

fields.label: Amount outstanding
fields.definition: Face amount of the issue currently outstanding, in the issue currency, including every reopening known at knownAt.

fields.label: Ask size
fields.definition: Quantity displayed at the best offer, in shares for equities and in contracts for options.

fields.label: Asset class
fields.definition: Internal asset class that chooses the function variant and the entitlement row: one of the ten values `equity`, `etf`, `index`, `fx`, `govt`, `option`, `future`, `crypto`, `rate`, `econ`.

fields.label: ATM implied vol
fields.definition: At-the-money implied volatility of the nearest listed expiry with at least seven days to expiry, interpolated between the two strikes bracketing the underlying price, in percent.
fields.derivation: linear interpolation of OPT_IV between the strikes bracketing UNDL_PX at the nearest expiry ≥ 7 d

fields.label: Bar time
fields.definition: Start of the interval a forming intraday bar covers, in UTC. On the b1m: subject a delta with IS_FINAL=true closes the bar and the next delta opens a new BAR_TS.

fields.label: Beta (1 year)
fields.definition: OLS slope of the instrument’s daily returns on the benchmark’s daily returns over the trailing 252 sessions — how much the instrument moves for a one-unit move in the benchmark.
fields.derivation: cov(r_i, r_b) / var(r_b) over 252 sessions, equal to the OLS slope

fields.label: Bond-equivalent yield
fields.definition: Investment yield of a bill on the ACT/365 coupon-equivalent basis, in percent, so it can be compared with a note’s YLD_YTM_MID. Bills of 182 days or less use the simple formula; longer bills use the quadratic solution that accounts for the intermediate coupon.
fields.derivation: 365 d / (360 − d·t) for t ≤ 182 days; the quadratic coupon-equivalent above 182

fields.label: Bid size
fields.definition: Quantity displayed at the best bid, in shares for equities and in contracts for options.

fields.label: Bond type
fields.definition: Treasury instrument family the terms belong to: a discount `bill`, a `note`, a `bond`, an inflation-linked `tips` or a floating-rate `frn`. It chooses the pricing convention.

fields.label: Total assets
fields.definition: Total assets on the balance sheet at the period end, as reported.

fields.label: Total liabilities
fields.definition: Total liabilities on the balance sheet at the period end. When the filer tags only LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity, the value is that figure less total equity, and the derivation is recorded in the statement provenance.

fields.label: Build id
fields.definition: Identifier of the curve build the c: subject currently carries (curve_builds.build_id).
fields.derivation: curve_builds.build_id

fields.label: Build time
fields.definition: Time the curve build completed, in UTC.
fields.derivation: curve_builds.built_at

fields.label: Business day convention
fields.definition: Rule that moves a scheduled date falling on a holiday: `following`, `modified_following`, `preceding`, or `none` for a Treasury, whose dates are unadjusted.

fields.label: Action amount
fields.definition: Cash per share the action pays, in CA_CRNCY: the dividend rate, the capital return or the tender price. Blank for an action that pays no cash.

fields.label: Action currency
fields.definition: ISO 4217 currency CA_AMOUNT is paid in, which need not be the trading currency.

fields.label: Declared date
fields.definition: Date the issuer announced the action. Blank while the action is only an estimate.

fields.label: Effective date
fields.definition: Date a structural action takes effect — the first session under the new ticker, the new name or the post-merger line. Blank for a dividend.

fields.label: Ex date
fields.definition: First session on which the security trades without entitlement to the action. It is the date the price adjustment factors are keyed to (REF-09).

fields.label: Dividend frequency
fields.definition: How often the issuer has been paying this kind of dividend, inferred from the paid history: `quarterly`, `semiannual`, `annual` or `irregular`. It is what an estimated future pay date rests on.

fields.label: Gross or net
fields.definition: Whether CA_AMOUNT is before (`gross`) or after (`net`) withholding tax. Total-return series built from the two are not comparable.

fields.label: New ticker
fields.definition: Ticker the security trades under after a ticker change, or the acquirer’s ticker after a merger. Blank for every action that does not change the line.

fields.label: Pay date
fields.definition: Date the cash or the new shares actually reach the holder.

fields.label: Ratio, new
fields.definition: New-share side of a share-count action: 4 for a 4:1 split, 1 for a 1:10 reverse split, 105 for a 5 % stock dividend. Read with CA_RATIO_OLD.

fields.label: Ratio, old
fields.definition: Old-share side of a share-count action: 1 for a 4:1 split, 10 for a 1:10 reverse split, 100 for a 5 % stock dividend. The price factor is CA_RATIO_OLD / CA_RATIO_NEW.

fields.label: Record date
fields.definition: Date on which a holder must be on the register to receive the action.

fields.label: Action status
fields.definition: How firm the action is (DATA-08): `estimated` from a pattern, `announced` by the issuer, `confirmed` against a filing, `paid`, or `cancelled`. An estimate is never shown as a fact.

fields.label: Action type
fields.definition: What the corporate action is: a cash, special or stock dividend, a split or reverse split, a spinoff, merger, tender, rights issue, call, conversion, name or ticker change, a delisting or a capital return.

fields.label: Capital expenditure
fields.definition: Payments to acquire property, plant and equipment for the period, reported as a positive outflow so that free cash flow is CF_CASH_FROM_OPER − CF_CAP_EXPEND.

fields.label: Cash from operations
fields.definition: Net cash provided by operating activities for the period, from the cash-flow statement.

fields.label: Change field family
fields.definition: Not a field: the CHG_* prefix, harvested from wildcard references to the change family (the cells that flash and carry a direction arrow). Use CHG_NET_1D or CHG_PCT_1D.

fields.label: Net change
fields.definition: PX_LAST minus PX_CLOSE_1D, in the instrument currency, from one and the same quote snapshot. Unavailable rather than zero when either input is missing.
fields.derivation: PX_LAST − PX_CLOSE_1D

fields.label: Percent change
fields.definition: CHG_NET_1D as a percentage of PX_CLOSE_1D. The previous close is unadjusted, so on an ex-dividend or split date the change is the raw one the tape shows, and the corporate action is flagged on the line.
fields.derivation: (PX_LAST − PX_CLOSE_1D) / PX_CLOSE_1D × 100

fields.label: Country of domicile
fields.definition: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country in which the issuing entity is domiciled.

fields.label: Country of issue
fields.definition: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the security was issued in — the ISIN prefix, which need not equal the domicile of the issuer.

fields.label: Website
fields.definition: Public website of the issuer as recorded on its SEC submissions record.

fields.label: Conflation floor
fields.definition: Global lower bound on every session’s effective conflation interval, in milliseconds. 0 when the plant is healthy; raised to 1000 under overload (ARCHITECTURE §6.3).
fields.derivation: 1000 while PLANT_STATE is degraded, else 0

fields.label: Contracts
fields.definition: Number of listed option contracts in the chain of the underlying.
fields.derivation: count of listed contracts

fields.label: Convexity
fields.definition: Second-order price sensitivity in years²: the curvature of the price-yield curve, (1/P) × d²P/dy² with the yield in decimal on the issue’s compounding basis. It is what the first-order DUR_ADJ_MID estimate misses for a large yield move.
fields.derivation: (1/PX_DIRTY_MID) × Σ t(t + 1/f) · PV(cf_t) / (1 + y/f)²

fields.label: Correlation to benchmark (1 year)
fields.definition: Pearson correlation of the instrument’s daily returns with the benchmark’s over the trailing 252 sessions, between −1 and +1.
fields.derivation: cov(r_i, r_b) / (stdev(r_i) × stdev(r_b)) over 252 sessions

fields.label: Coupon
fields.definition: Annual coupon rate fixed by the terms of the issue, in percent of par; null for a discount bill, the current reset rate for a floating-rate note.

fields.label: Coupon upper bound (screener token)
fields.definition: Not a field: the SRCH screener keyed token CPNTO=<rate>, which bounds a coupon filter from above. The coupon itself is carried by CPN_FREQ and the govt terms block.

fields.label: Coupon frequency
fields.definition: Number of coupon payments per year fixed by the terms of the issue: 2 for a US Treasury note or bond, 0 for a discount bill.

fields.label: Coupon type
fields.definition: How the coupon is determined: `fixed`, `zero` (a bill), `float` (an FRN over a reference index), `step` or `inflation_linked` (TIPS).

fields.label: Currency
fields.definition: ISO 4217 code of the currency the instrument trades and settles in; every price and currency-unit field on the screen is in it unless a field says otherwise.

fields.label: Treasury par yield (10 year)
fields.definition: Constant-maturity par yield of the US Treasury curve at the 10 year tenor, in percent — the coupon a par bond of that maturity would carry on the curve build of CURVE_DATE.
fields.derivation: published CMT point, or CURVE_PAR of the active build at t = 10 year

fields.label: Treasury par yield (1 month)
fields.definition: Constant-maturity par yield of the US Treasury curve at the 1 month tenor, in percent — the coupon a par bond of that maturity would carry on the curve build of CURVE_DATE.
fields.derivation: published CMT point, or CURVE_PAR of the active build at t = 1 month

fields.label: Treasury par yield (1 year)
fields.definition: Constant-maturity par yield of the US Treasury curve at the 1 year tenor, in percent — the coupon a par bond of that maturity would carry on the curve build of CURVE_DATE.
fields.derivation: published CMT point, or CURVE_PAR of the active build at t = 1 year

fields.label: Treasury par yield (20 year)
fields.definition: Constant-maturity par yield of the US Treasury curve at the 20 year tenor, in percent — the coupon a par bond of that maturity would carry on the curve build of CURVE_DATE.
fields.derivation: published CMT point, or CURVE_PAR of the active build at t = 20 year

fields.label: Treasury par yield (2 month)
fields.definition: Constant-maturity par yield of the US Treasury curve at the 2 month tenor, in percent — the coupon a par bond of that maturity would carry on the curve build of CURVE_DATE.
fields.derivation: published CMT point, or CURVE_PAR of the active build at t = 2 month

fields.label: Treasury par yield (2 year)
fields.definition: Constant-maturity par yield of the US Treasury curve at the 2 year tenor, in percent — the coupon a par bond of that maturity would carry on the curve build of CURVE_DATE.
fields.derivation: published CMT point, or CURVE_PAR of the active build at t = 2 year

fields.label: Treasury par yield (30 year)
fields.definition: Constant-maturity par yield of the US Treasury curve at the 30 year tenor, in percent — the coupon a par bond of that maturity would carry on the curve build of CURVE_DATE.
fields.derivation: published CMT point, or CURVE_PAR of the active build at t = 30 year

fields.label: Treasury par yield (3 month)
fields.definition: Constant-maturity par yield of the US Treasury curve at the 3 month tenor, in percent — the coupon a par bond of that maturity would carry on the curve build of CURVE_DATE.
fields.derivation: published CMT point, or CURVE_PAR of the active build at t = 3 month

fields.label: Treasury par yield (3 year)
fields.definition: Constant-maturity par yield of the US Treasury curve at the 3 year tenor, in percent — the coupon a par bond of that maturity would carry on the curve build of CURVE_DATE.
fields.derivation: published CMT point, or CURVE_PAR of the active build at t = 3 year

fields.label: Treasury par yield (5 year)
fields.definition: Constant-maturity par yield of the US Treasury curve at the 5 year tenor, in percent — the coupon a par bond of that maturity would carry on the curve build of CURVE_DATE.
fields.derivation: published CMT point, or CURVE_PAR of the active build at t = 5 year

fields.label: Treasury par yield (6 month)
fields.definition: Constant-maturity par yield of the US Treasury curve at the 6 month tenor, in percent — the coupon a par bond of that maturity would carry on the curve build of CURVE_DATE.
fields.derivation: published CMT point, or CURVE_PAR of the active build at t = 6 month

fields.label: Treasury par yield (7 year)
fields.definition: Constant-maturity par yield of the US Treasury curve at the 7 year tenor, in percent — the coupon a par bond of that maturity would carry on the curve build of CURVE_DATE.
fields.derivation: published CMT point, or CURVE_PAR of the active build at t = 7 year

fields.label: Curve date
fields.definition: Valuation date of the curve build: the session whose quotes the pillars were taken from.
fields.derivation: curve_builds.curve_date

fields.label: Discount factor
fields.definition: Present value on the built curve of one unit paid at the requested time. Strictly positive and non-increasing in t for an arbitrage-free build; 1.0 at the curve date.
fields.derivation: exp(−CURVE_ZERO/100 × t) from the bootstrapped nodes

fields.label: Forward rate (3 month)
fields.definition: Three-month forward rate implied by the built curve starting at the requested time, in percent: the rate the curve says will apply over the three months after that date.
fields.derivation: (CURVE_DF(t1)/CURVE_DF(t2) − 1) / (t2 − t1), ×100 with t2 = t1 + 0.25

fields.label: Par rate
fields.definition: Par rate of the built curve at the requested time to maturity, in percent: the coupon that prices a bond of that maturity at 100 off the curve’s own discount factors.
fields.derivation: (1 − CURVE_DF(T)) / Σ accrualFactor_i × CURVE_DF(t_i), ×100

fields.label: Zero rate
fields.definition: Continuously-compounded zero-coupon rate of the built curve at the requested time, in percent — the rate that discounts a single cash flow at that maturity. The curve’s interpolation (linear_zero, log_linear_df or monotone_convex) is echoed with the build.
fields.derivation: −ln(CURVE_DF(t)) / t × 100

fields.label: Market capitalisation
fields.definition: PX_LAST multiplied by EQY_SH_OUT, in the listing currency. It moves on every tick while the share count stays at the last filing, so it is point-in-time through its share input.
fields.derivation: PX_LAST × EQY_SH_OUT

fields.label: Dated date
fields.definition: Date from which interest begins to accrue, which for a reopened issue is earlier than the issue date and is what the accrued-interest calculation starts from.

fields.label: Days to maturity
fields.definition: Actual calendar days from the settlement date used by the analytic to the maturity date. The day count that drives the bill formulas, and the branch that picks the ≤ 182-day or > 182-day investment-yield formula.
fields.derivation: MATURITY − settlement date, in actual days

fields.label: Day count
fields.definition: Day-count convention of the issue — `ACT/ACT` for Treasury notes and bonds, `ACT/360` for bills — which fixes how accrual and discounting count days (ANAL-01).

fields.label: Day-count fraction
fields.definition: Fraction of the current coupon period that has elapsed at settlement on the issue’s day-count convention: ACCRUED_DAYS over the days in the period. ACCRUED is the coupon times this.
fields.derivation: ACCRUED_DAYS / days in the coupon period, on the issue convention

fields.label: Discount rate (bill)
fields.definition: Treasury bill discount rate in percent on the ACT/360 bank-discount basis, quoted off the face rather than the price. It is not a return: BEY is the comparable yield.
fields.derivation: (100 − price) / 100 × 360 / daysToMaturity × 100

fields.label: Modified duration
fields.definition: Percentage change in dirty price for a 100 bp parallel change in yield: Macaulay duration divided by (1 + y/f). The first-order risk number YAS and the curve screens quote.
fields.derivation: DUR_MID / (1 + YLD_YTM_MID/100 / CPN_FREQ)

fields.label: Macaulay duration
fields.definition: Cash-flow-weighted average time to receipt, in years, discounted at YLD_YTM_MID. Not a price sensitivity on its own — DUR_ADJ_MID is.
fields.derivation: Σ t·PV(cf_t) / Σ PV(cf_t) at y = YLD_YTM_MID

fields.label: DV01
fields.definition: Dollar value of one basis point: the change in the position’s value, in the instrument currency, for a one basis point parallel fall in yield, on the face amount the analytic was run with. Positive for a long position.
fields.derivation: DUR_ADJ_MID × PX_DIRTY_MID × face / 100 × 0.0001

fields.label: DV01 per 100 face
fields.definition: DV01 expressed in price points per 100 of face, so it is comparable across issues without knowing the face amount. DV01 = DV01_PER_100 × face / 100.
fields.derivation: DUR_ADJ_MID × PX_DIRTY_MID × 0.0001

fields.label: Dividends per share (12M)
fields.definition: Sum of the cash dividends with an ex-date in the twelve months ending at validAt, per share, in the listing currency. Special dividends are included and flagged in provenance.

fields.label: Dividend yield
fields.definition: Trailing twelve-month cash dividends per share over PX_LAST, in percent. Zero-dividend issuers report 0, not unavailable.
fields.derivation: DVD_SH_12M / PX_LAST × 100

fields.label: Economic field family
fields.definition: Not a field: the ECO_* prefix, harvested from wildcard references to the economic-release family. Use the concrete member — ECO_VALUE, ECO_PERIOD, ECO_RELEASE_DT, ECO_VINTAGE.

fields.label: Observation period
fields.definition: First day of the period the observation describes — 2026-08-01 for August 2026, 2026-07-01 for Q3 2026 — never the date the figure was published.

fields.label: Prior value
fields.definition: Value of the previous observation period as it stood in this release — the comparison the publisher printed, so it already reflects any revision made to that period by this release.

fields.label: Release date
fields.definition: Date the publisher released this observation. It is the knownAt of the value: a run as of the day before it returns the previous vintage instead.

fields.label: Observation value
fields.definition: Value of the economic series for the observation period, in the unit the publisher uses (index level, percent, thousands of persons). The unit is a property of the series, so a screen must render it with the series metadata rather than assume percent.

fields.label: Vintage
fields.definition: Identifier of the release this value came from, as the publisher labels it (an ALFRED vintage date, a BLS release id). Two vintages of one period are two rows, never an update.

fields.label: Basic EPS (statement line)
fields.definition: The normalised income-statement line `EPS_BASIC`: net income attributable to common shareholders divided by the weighted average basic share count, as reported.

fields.label: Diluted EPS (statement line)
fields.definition: The normalised income-statement line `EPS_DIL`, the row FA and the EQS screener read. Identical in meaning to IS_EPS_DIL.

fields.label: Free float
fields.definition: Publicly floated shares as a percentage of EQY_SH_OUT: shares outstanding less the holdings reported as restricted or insider-held in the latest filing.
fields.derivation: PUBLIC_FLOAT / EQY_SH_OUT × 100

fields.label: Shares outstanding
fields.definition: Number of common shares issued and outstanding as reported on the cover page of the most recent periodic filing known at knownAt. Not adjusted for splits after that filing date.

fields.label: Trading calendar
fields.definition: Identifier of the trading calendar (REF-06) whose holidays and early closes govern the instrument: `XNYS`, `XNAS`, `XCBO`, `SIFMA`, `USGOVT`, `FX_USD`.

fields.label: Exchange code
fields.definition: OpenFIGI composite exchange code that follows the ticker on the command line — `US` for a US composite, `GOVT`, `FX`, `INDEX`, `RATE`, `ECON`, `CRYPTO` for the non-listed classes.

fields.label: Exchange time zone
fields.definition: IANA time zone of the primary venue; every session time on a screen is rendered in it unless the user has asked for local time.

fields.label: Expiries
fields.definition: Comma-separated ISO dates of every listed expiry in the option chain of the underlying, ascending, on the oc: subject.
fields.derivation: sorted distinct expiry dates of the chain

fields.label: First coupon date
fields.definition: Date of the first coupon paid by the issue. When it is not one full period after the dated date, the first period is short or long and the schedule is built backwards from maturity.

fields.label: First trade date
fields.definition: Earliest session for which the terminal holds a price for the instrument; the left edge of every chart and the floor of a GP range request.

fields.label: Fiscal year end
fields.definition: Month and day on which the issuer closes its financial year, as `MMDD` — `0926` for a late-September year end. It fixes which quarter a filing belongs to.

fields.label: Floating spread
fields.definition: Spread added to the reference index at each reset of a floating-rate note, in basis points.

fields.label: FX rate missing
fields.definition: True when no fx_rates row existed for the instrument currency on or before the analytic date, so the row could not be converted and was excluded from the totals. The reason travels with the row as NO_SOURCE on FX_USD.
fields.derivation: FX_USD is null for the row’s currency at the analytic date

fields.label: FX rate to USD
fields.definition: Rate used to convert one unit of the instrument currency into USD for the run, taken from the fx_rates row valid at the analytic date. Published so a converted figure can be undone.
fields.derivation: fx_rates(ccy → USD) on or before the analytic date

fields.label: GICS industry code
fields.definition: Six-digit GICS level-3 industry code assigned to the issuer.

fields.label: GICS industry group
fields.definition: Name of the GICS level-2 industry group (four-digit code) the issuer sits in.

fields.label: GICS industry
fields.definition: Name of the GICS level-3 industry the issuer is classified into.

fields.label: GICS sector code
fields.definition: Two-digit GICS level-1 sector code assigned to the issuer, e.g. `45` Information Technology.

fields.label: GICS sector
fields.definition: Name of the GICS level-1 sector, the grouping MEMB subtotals and SECF facets by.

fields.label: GICS sub-industry
fields.definition: Name of the GICS level-4 sub-industry, the finest classification the terminal stores.

fields.label: Headline
fields.definition: Headline text of the story as published, with the publisher’s own prefixes kept.

fields.label: Bar high
fields.definition: Highest trade price inside one intraday bar of the requested interval. Unlike PX_HIGH it is a property of the bar, so it only exists on a bar-bearing subject (b1m:) or a history row.

fields.label: Holding as-of date
fields.definition: Reporting-period end the holder’s position refers to. A holders table is always as of a filing date in the past, never live.

fields.label: Holder
fields.definition: Name of the entity holding the position, as the filing that disclosed it spells it — a fund on an N-PORT row, the registrant on an insider form.

fields.label: Position value
fields.definition: Value of the reported position in USD at the as-of date of the filing.

fields.label: Percent outstanding held
fields.definition: Reported position as a percentage of shares outstanding at the same as-of date; null when the share count is not known for that date.

fields.label: Shares held
fields.definition: Share count the holder reported for the position at the as-of date of the filing.

fields.label: Membership as-of date
fields.definition: Effective date of the holdings file the weight and share count come from — the N-PORT reporting period end or the SSGA file date, not the date the file was published.

fields.label: Member count
fields.definition: Number of constituents the index has at the as-of date of its latest membership file.

fields.label: Index market value held
fields.definition: Market value of the member held by the index vehicle at the effective date of the holdings file, in USD as the filing reports it.

fields.label: Index shares held
fields.definition: Share count of the member held by the index vehicle at the effective date of the holdings file; the basis of the weight when the index is share-weighted.

fields.label: Member since
fields.definition: First date on which the member appears in the index membership history the terminal holds. It is the start of the bitemporal membership row, not an index-provider announcement date.

fields.label: Membership source
fields.definition: Which feed the membership row came from: an N-PORT filing of the proxy fund (`sec.archives`) or the fund manager’s own holdings file (`ssga.holdings`).

fields.label: Index weight
fields.definition: Weight of the member in the index as of the effective date of the holdings file, expressed as a fraction of the index (0.0712 = 7.12 %).

fields.label: Index provider
fields.definition: Organisation that calculates and publishes the index.

fields.label: Membership proxy fund
fields.definition: Fund whose published holdings the terminal uses as the membership of the index, because the index provider does not publish constituents — SPY for SPX. Blank when none is needed.

fields.label: Index ratio base
fields.definition: Reference CPI level at the dated date of an inflation-linked issue; today’s index ratio is the current reference CPI divided by it.

fields.label: Composite FIGI
fields.definition: OpenFIGI composite-level FIGI of the instrument — the 12-character identity of the composite ticker, stable across venue and across a ticker change.

fields.label: Share class FIGI
fields.definition: OpenFIGI share-class-level FIGI of the issue: the same value for every composite and venue listing of one share class worldwide.

fields.label: CIK
fields.definition: SEC Central Index Key of the issuer, zero-padded to ten digits as `data.sec.gov` returns it; the unpadded form is what `/Archives` paths take (§18.6).

fields.label: CUSIP
fields.definition: Nine-character CUSIP of the issue, the last character being the mod-10 double-add-double check digit; the loadable ticker of a US Treasury.

fields.label: Local ticker
fields.definition: Symbol the primary venue itself uses for the listing, which may differ from the composite ticker (class suffixes, dot and dash conventions).

fields.label: Listing FIGI
fields.definition: OpenFIGI venue-level FIGI of the primary listing (the `UW`, `UN`, `UP` line), as opposed to the composite FIGI carried by ID_BB_GLOBAL.

fields.label: ISIN
fields.definition: ISO 6166 International Securities Identification Number of the issue: two-letter country prefix, nine-character NSIN and a Luhn check digit over the letter expansion.

fields.label: LEI
fields.definition: ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier of the issuer: twenty characters identifying the legal person, not the security.

fields.label: OCC contract symbol
fields.definition: OCC option symbol in the Cboe form the feed publishes, root unpadded: `AAPL260916C00245000` — root, YYMMDD expiry, C/P and the strike in thousandths.

fields.label: SEDOL
fields.definition: Seven-character SEDOL of the issue, the last character being the 1-3-1-7-3-9 weighted check digit.

fields.label: Ticker
fields.definition: Composite-level ticker the user types on the command line (`AAPL`, `SPX`, `EURUSD`, a Treasury CUSIP). Never an identity on its own: a ticker is reused across time (REF-01).

fields.label: Information ratio (1 year)
fields.definition: Annualised active return divided by annualised tracking error over the trailing window: return per unit of risk taken away from the benchmark.
fields.derivation: mean(r_i − r_b) × 252 / (stdev(r_i − r_b, ddof = 1) × sqrt(252))

fields.label: Issuer type
fields.definition: What kind of legal person issued the security: an operating company, a fund, a sovereign, an index provider, a central bank, or anything else.

fields.label: Issue date
fields.definition: Date the security was first settled to buyers at auction.

fields.label: Callable
fields.definition: True when the issuer may redeem the issue before maturity under a call schedule; false for every modern US Treasury.

fields.label: Correction
fields.definition: True when the publisher marked this story as a correction or a replacement of an earlier one. A corrected story is shown in place of the original and flagged in the story pane.

fields.label: Diluted EPS
fields.definition: Diluted earnings per share for the period as reported, on the share count the filer used. Prior periods carry the filer’s own retroactive split adjustment, not the terminal’s.

fields.label: Bar final
fields.definition: True once the interval of an intraday bar has closed and the bar will not be revised. The in-progress bar of the current interval is always false and is redrawn on every update.
fields.derivation: barTs + interval ≤ validAt

fields.label: Operating income
fields.definition: Income from operations: revenue less cost of revenue and operating expenses, before non-operating items and tax, as reported.

fields.label: Implied volatility (30d)
fields.definition: At-the-money implied volatility at a constant 30-day horizon, in percent, interpolated in total variance between the two listed expiries that bracket 30 days on the fitted surface.
fields.derivation: linear interpolation in σ²T between the bracketing expiries at k = 0, ×100

fields.label: Kind
fields.definition: What the item is: a news story, a regulatory filing or a central-bank release.

fields.label: Key-rate duration (10y)
fields.definition: Price sensitivity in years to a 1 bp triangular bump of the 10-year node of the zero curve, the issue’s z-spread held fixed.
fields.derivation: −(P⁺ − P⁻) / (2 × P × 0.0001) for a ±1 bp triangular bump at 10y

fields.label: Key-rate duration (2y)
fields.definition: Price sensitivity in years to a 1 bp bump of the 2-year node of the pricing curve’s zero curve, with a triangular kernel peaking at 2y and the issue’s z-spread held fixed. The key-rate durations sum to DUR_ADJ_MID.
fields.derivation: −(P⁺ − P⁻) / (2 × P × 0.0001) for a ±1 bp triangular bump at 2y

fields.label: Key-rate duration (30y)
fields.definition: Price sensitivity in years to a 1 bp bump of the 30-year node of the zero curve, flat beyond the last key tenor, the issue’s z-spread held fixed.
fields.derivation: −(P⁺ − P⁻) / (2 × P × 0.0001) for a ±1 bp triangular bump at 30y

fields.label: Key-rate duration (5y)
fields.definition: Price sensitivity in years to a 1 bp triangular bump of the 5-year node of the zero curve, the issue’s z-spread held fixed. Zero for a bond with no cash flow near 5 years.
fields.derivation: −(P⁺ − P⁻) / (2 × P × 0.0001) for a ±1 bp triangular bump at 5y

fields.label: Last trade size
fields.definition: Quantity of the trade that set PX_LAST, in shares or contracts.

fields.label: Last trade time
fields.definition: Exchange timestamp of the trade that set PX_LAST, in UTC. It is the event time the staleness indicator measures against, never the time the row was ingested.

fields.label: Link
fields.definition: Canonical URL of the story at the publisher; opened by the story pane.

fields.label: Listing status
fields.definition: State of the primary listing at the venue — trading, suspended or delisted — which can differ from SECURITY_STATUS when only one of several venues has stopped.

fields.label: Issuer legal name
fields.definition: Registered legal name of the issuing entity as the filer reports it, including the legal suffix that `text/normName.ts` strips when it matches names.

fields.label: Market sector
fields.definition: Sector word that closes a command-line reference and disambiguates a ticker: one of the eleven market sectors the parser accepts (`Equity`, `Index`, `Curncy`, `Govt`, …).

fields.label: Maturity date
fields.definition: Date on which the principal is repaid and the security stops accruing. It closes every cash-flow schedule and is the anchor of the yield and duration calculations.

fields.label: Maximum drawdown (1 year)
fields.definition: Largest peak-to-trough fall of the compounded return series over the trailing window, in percent. Always ≤ 0; 0 means the series never fell below a previous peak.
fields.derivation: min over t of (V_t / max_{s ≤ t} V_s − 1), ×100, on the compounded series

fields.label: Minimum client
fields.definition: Lowest web client version the server still serves; an older client is told to reload on the next hello.
fields.derivation: config.minClientVersion

fields.label: Minimum increment
fields.definition: Face amount by which a holding above the minimum denomination may be increased.

fields.label: Minimum denomination
fields.definition: Smallest face amount that may be held, in the issue currency (100 for a US Treasury).

fields.label: Money-market yield
fields.definition: Bill yield on the ACT/360 money-market basis, in percent — the discount rate restated as a return on the price paid rather than on the face received.
fields.derivation: 360 × d / (360 − d × daysToMaturity)

fields.label: Name
fields.definition: Display name of the instrument as the terminal shows it in a panel title, a search result and a CSV header — the short form, not the legal name.

fields.label: Net income (statement line)
fields.definition: The normalised income-statement line `NET_INC` of fin_statements: the numerator of NET_MARGIN, ROE and ROA. Identical in meaning to NET_INCOME.

fields.label: Net income
fields.definition: Net income attributable to the parent for the period, after tax and minority interest, as reported on the income statement.

fields.label: Net margin
fields.definition: Net income over revenue for the same reported period, in percent. Both inputs come from one statement version, so a restatement moves them together.
fields.derivation: NET_INC / SALES_REV_TURN × 100

fields.label: Story id
fields.definition: Stable terminal identifier of a headline, derived from the feed’s own guid. It is what NLRT alerts, saved stories and the story pane address, and it survives a re-poll of the feed.

fields.label: Next coupon date
fields.definition: First scheduled coupon date strictly after the valuation date, taken from the generated schedule; it closes the current accrual period.

fields.label: On the run
fields.definition: True when the issue is the most recently auctioned security of its term, and therefore the benchmark the curve and spread screens quote against.

fields.label: Open incidents
fields.definition: Number of unresolved data-quality incidents (dq_events rows without a resolved_at) at SERVER_TIME.
fields.derivation: count(dq_events where resolved_at is null)

fields.label: Option field family
fields.definition: Not a field: the OPT_* prefix, harvested from wildcard references to the option field family. Use the concrete member — OPT_STRIKE_PX, OPT_DELTA, OPT_IV and the rest.

fields.label: AM/PM settlement
fields.definition: Whether the settlement price is struck from the opening prints (`am`, typical of quarterly index options) or the close (`pm`, the standard for listed equity options).

fields.label: Break-even
fields.definition: Underlying price at expiry at which the position returns its premium: strike plus premium for a long call, strike minus premium for a long put.
fields.derivation: OPT_STRIKE_PX ± mid premium, by put/call

fields.label: Charm
fields.definition: Second-order sensitivity ∂²V/∂S∂t: the drift of delta over one calendar day with the underlying unchanged.
fields.derivation: ∂²V/∂S∂t per calendar day under BSM

fields.label: Contract size
fields.definition: Number of underlying units one contract delivers — 100 shares for a standard US equity option, less after an adjustment for a corporate action.

fields.label: Delta
fields.definition: Change in the option’s value for a one-unit change in the underlying price, per contract unit. Positive for calls, negative for puts.
fields.derivation: ∂V/∂S — venue-published, reproduced by core/analytics/option/greeks.ts

fields.label: Dividend yield used
fields.definition: Continuous dividend yield the valuation assumed for the underlying, from the trailing twelve-month cash dividends over the underlying price. Published for reproducibility.
fields.derivation: DVD_SH_12M / OPT_UNDL_PX, continuous

fields.label: Exercise style
fields.definition: Whether the holder may exercise on any business day up to expiry (`american`) or only at expiry (`european`); it decides whether early exercise has to be priced.

fields.label: Expiration date
fields.definition: Last date on which the option may be exercised, parsed from the OCC symbol; the expiry cut itself is a property of the venue, not of this field.

fields.label: Forward price (chain-implied)
fields.definition: Forward price of the underlying for the option’s expiry implied by put-call parity across the chain’s most liquid strikes. It is the abscissa the SVI slice is fitted in, so it is published with the fit.
fields.derivation: K* + (call(K*) − put(K*)) · e^{rT} at the least-absolute-difference strike K*

fields.label: Gamma
fields.definition: Change in delta for a one-unit change in the underlying price.
fields.derivation: ∂²V/∂S²

fields.label: Implied volatility (mid, computed)
fields.definition: Volatility that reprices the option to the mid of PX_BID and PX_ASK under the terminal’s Black-Scholes-Merton implementation, on OPT_RATE_USED and OPT_DVD_YIELD_USED. Unavailable when the series has no two-sided quote.
fields.derivation: Brent solve of BSM(σ) = (PX_BID + PX_ASK)/2

fields.label: Intrinsic value
fields.definition: Value the option would have on immediate exercise: max(S − K, 0) for a call, max(K − S, 0) for a put, using OPT_UNDL_PX. Never negative.
fields.derivation: max(OPT_UNDL_PX − OPT_STRIKE_PX, 0) for a call; the mirror for a put

fields.label: Weekly
fields.definition: True when the series is a weekly expiry rather than one of the monthly third-Friday expiries; OMON groups its chains separately.

fields.label: Implied volatility (venue)
fields.definition: Implied volatility of the series as published by the venue, annualised, in percent. It is the venue’s model on the venue’s inputs; OPT_IMPL_VOL_MID is the terminal’s own solve.
fields.derivation: venue-published; no terminal engine involved

fields.label: Last trade date
fields.definition: Last session on which the series may be traded, which for a standard US equity option is the expiry itself and for an AM-settled series is the business day before it.

fields.label: Log-moneyness
fields.definition: Natural logarithm of strike over OPT_FWD_PX — the x-axis of the SVI slice. Negative below the forward, zero at the money, positive above it.
fields.derivation: ln(OPT_STRIKE_PX / OPT_FWD_PX)

fields.label: Model price
fields.definition: Option value from the terminal’s own Black-Scholes-Merton valuation at OPT_IMPL_VOL_MID (or the surface value when the series is unquoted), stated per contract unit.
fields.derivation: BSM(S = OPT_UNDL_PX, K, T, r = OPT_RATE_USED, q = OPT_DVD_YIELD_USED, σ)

fields.label: Contract multiplier
fields.definition: Factor that turns one point of option price into currency — 100 for a standard listed equity option. Premium paid = price x multiplier.

fields.label: Open interest
fields.definition: Number of contracts of this option series outstanding at the end of the previous session, as published by the clearing house through the venue.

fields.label: Put/call
fields.definition: Whether the series is a call (C) or a put (P), from the OCC symbol.

fields.label: Discount rate used
fields.definition: Continuously-compounded risk-free rate the valuation used, interpolated from the Treasury par curve at the option’s time to expiry. Published so that a model price is reproducible.
fields.derivation: log-linear interpolation of CURVE_ZERO at T = (OPT_EXPIRE_DT − validAt)/365

fields.label: Rho
fields.definition: Change in the option’s value for a one-percentage-point change in the discount rate.
fields.derivation: ∂V/∂r per rate point

fields.label: Option root
fields.definition: Root symbol of the option series as the OCC symbol carries it, unpadded in the Cboe form and padded to six characters in the OSI form.

fields.label: Settlement type
fields.definition: What exercise delivers: the underlying shares (`physical`) or a cash difference (`cash`, as for an index option).

fields.label: Strike price
fields.definition: Exercise price of the option series, in the contract currency.

fields.label: Theoretical value (venue)
fields.definition: Theoretical option value published by the venue alongside its greeks. Compare with OPT_MODEL_PX, which is the terminal’s own valuation on the terminal’s rate and dividend assumptions.
fields.derivation: venue-published theoretical value

fields.label: Theta
fields.definition: Change in the option’s value for the passage of one calendar day, holding everything else constant. Negative for a long option away from a dividend.
fields.derivation: ∂V/∂t per calendar day

fields.label: Tick size
fields.definition: Smallest price increment the series may be quoted in, in the contract currency.

fields.label: Time value
fields.definition: The part of the option’s price that is not intrinsic: the mid price less OPT_INTRINSIC. Goes to zero at expiry by construction.
fields.derivation: (PX_BID + PX_ASK)/2 − OPT_INTRINSIC

fields.label: Underlying price
fields.definition: Price of the underlying instrument used to quote and to value this option, taken from the same snapshot as the chain so the greeks and the underlying never disagree.

fields.label: Underlying ticker
fields.definition: Display ticker of the instrument the option delivers, as the terminal resolves it — the root symbol of the OCC code mapped back onto a loadable security.

fields.label: Vanna
fields.definition: Second-order sensitivity ∂²V/∂S∂σ: how delta moves when implied volatility moves, per volatility point.
fields.derivation: ∂²V/∂S∂σ under BSM

fields.label: Vega
fields.definition: Change in the option’s value for a one-percentage-point change in implied volatility.
fields.derivation: ∂V/∂σ per volatility point

fields.label: Volga
fields.definition: Second-order sensitivity ∂²V/∂σ²: how vega moves when implied volatility moves, per volatility point.
fields.derivation: ∂²V/∂σ² under BSM

fields.label: Command-line reference
fields.definition: The security exactly as the command line accepts and re-formats it — `AAPL US Equity`, `SPX Index`, `EURUSD Curncy`, `912797VE4 Govt` — ticker, exchange code and market sector.

fields.label: Par value
fields.definition: Nominal value of one unit of the issue in the issue currency: the stated par of a share, or the redemption face of a bond (100 for a US Treasury).

fields.label: Period
fields.definition: Observation period of VALUE as an ISO date: the first day of the month, quarter or year it covers.

fields.label: Plant state
fields.definition: Health of the ticker plant on the sys:status subject: ok, degraded (event-loop lag or apply queue over budget, a global conflation floor is in force) or restarting (clients resync).
fields.derivation: degraded when event-loop lag > 200 ms or apply queue > 50 000

fields.label: Previous
fields.definition: The observation immediately before VALUE, as last published (revised where the publisher revised it).

fields.label: Primary exchange MIC
fields.definition: ISO 10383 market identifier code of the venue that carries the primary listing.

fields.label: Primary exchange
fields.definition: Name of the venue behind PRIM_EXCH_MIC, as the exchange register spells it.

fields.label: Providers down
fields.definition: Comma-separated source ids whose circuit breaker is open. Empty when every provider is reachable; a subject whose winning line is on a listed provider reports state stale.
fields.derivation: source ids with an open circuit breaker, joined by comma

fields.label: Published
fields.definition: Publisher timestamp of the story in UTC; the order headlines are delivered in on an n: subject.

fields.label: Put/call ratio
fields.definition: Total put volume divided by total call volume across the chain for the current session.
fields.derivation: Σ put PX_VOLUME / Σ call PX_VOLUME

fields.label: Ask
fields.definition: Best offer price displayed on the primary venue at the quote timestamp.

fields.label: Bid
fields.definition: Best bid price displayed on the primary venue at the quote timestamp.

fields.label: Clean price (mid)
fields.definition: Mid price per 100 of face excluding accrued interest — the quoted price of the bond. PX_CLEAN_MID + ACCRUED = PX_DIRTY_MID by construction.
fields.derivation: PX_DIRTY_MID − ACCRUED

fields.label: Previous close
fields.definition: Official closing price of the previous trading session, unadjusted for corporate actions. It is the denominator of CHG_PCT_1D and never changes intraday.

fields.label: Dirty price (mid)
fields.definition: Mid settlement price per 100 of face including accrued interest — what a buyer actually pays on the settlement date the analytic used.
fields.derivation: PX_CLEAN_MID + ACCRUED at the T+1 settlement date

fields.label: High
fields.definition: Highest trade price of the current regular session on the primary venue.

fields.label: 52-week high
fields.definition: Highest daily high of the trailing 52 weeks ending at validAt, adjusted for splits but not for dividends, from bars_daily.
fields.derivation: max(PX_HIGH) over the trailing 252 sessions, split-adjusted

fields.label: Last price
fields.definition: Price of the most recent trade on the primary venue, in the instrument currency. Outside trading hours it holds the last trade of the most recent session and the line reports the session state rather than a new timestamp.

fields.label: Low
fields.definition: Lowest trade price of the current regular session on the primary venue.

fields.label: 52-week low
fields.definition: Lowest daily low of the trailing 52 weeks ending at validAt, adjusted for splits but not for dividends, from bars_daily.
fields.derivation: min(PX_LOW) over the trailing 252 sessions, split-adjusted

fields.label: Official close
fields.definition: The venue's official closing print for the session, published after the closing auction. It is the value stored in bars_daily and the one every end-of-day analytic uses.

fields.label: Open
fields.definition: First trade price of the current regular session on the primary venue.

fields.label: Price to book
fields.definition: CUR_MKT_CAP divided by total common equity of the most recent reported period. Negative book value yields an unavailable value rather than a negative ratio.
fields.derivation: CUR_MKT_CAP / (TOT_ASSETS − TOT_LIAB)

fields.label: Price to sales
fields.definition: PX_LAST divided by SALES_PS, on trailing twelve-month revenue.
fields.derivation: PX_LAST / SALES_PS

fields.label: Volume
fields.definition: Consolidated number of shares or contracts traded in the current session to the quote timestamp. Index subjects report the volume of their constituents only where the venue does.

fields.label: Rate
fields.definition: Published level of a reference rate for the effective date, in percent (SOFR, EFFR, OBFR, the Treasury repo rates). It is the value the r: subject and the WIRP path key off.

fields.label: Rates
fields.definition: Comma-separated pillar rates in percent, positionally aligned with TENORS.
fields.derivation: CURVE_PAR at each pillar

fields.label: 1st percentile
fields.definition: First percentile of the transaction-weighted rate distribution behind RATE, in percent.

fields.label: 25th percentile
fields.definition: Twenty-fifth percentile of the transaction-weighted rate distribution behind RATE, in percent.

fields.label: 75th percentile
fields.definition: Seventy-fifth percentile of the transaction-weighted rate distribution behind RATE, in percent.

fields.label: 99th percentile
fields.definition: Ninety-ninth percentile of the transaction-weighted rate distribution behind RATE, in percent.

fields.label: Volume (bn)
fields.definition: Dollar volume of the transactions behind the rate fixing, in billions of US dollars.

fields.label: Reference index
fields.definition: Floating-rate index a coupon resets against — `SOFR` for a Treasury FRN. Empty for a fixed coupon.

fields.label: Released
fields.definition: Time the publisher released the observation carried in VALUE, in UTC.

fields.label: 1-day return
fields.definition: Price return over the last completed session, in percent, on the split-adjusted close series (adjustment policy `price`). Cash dividends are not reinvested, so an ex-dividend date does show as a drop — the dividend-reinvested figure is a separate field.
fields.derivation: close(t) / close(t − 1 session) − 1, ×100, on the price-adjusted series

fields.label: 1-month return
fields.definition: Price return over the trailing month, in percent, on the split-adjusted close series. t₋ is the last session on or before the same day of the previous month, clamped to that month’s length.
fields.derivation: close(t) / close(t₋) − 1, ×100, t₋ = last session ≤ t − 1 month (FUNCTIONS_TIER1 §0.3)

fields.label: 1-week return
fields.definition: Price return over the trailing week, in percent, on the split-adjusted close series. The window is a calendar offset resolved to a session: t₋ is the last session on or before t − 7 calendar days, so a holiday-shortened week is still a week.
fields.derivation: close(t) / close(t₋) − 1, ×100, t₋ = last session ≤ t − 7 calendar days (FUNCTIONS_TIER1 §0.3)

fields.label: 1-year return
fields.definition: Price return over the trailing year, in percent, on the split-adjusted close series. t₋ is the last session on or before t − 1 calendar year. Not annualised — it already covers one year.
fields.derivation: close(t) / close(t₋) − 1, ×100, t₋ = last session ≤ t − 1 year (FUNCTIONS_TIER1 §0.3)

fields.label: Year-to-date return
fields.definition: Price return from the last session of the previous calendar year to the last completed session, in percent, on the split-adjusted close series.
fields.derivation: close(t) / close(t₋) − 1, ×100, t₋ = last session of the previous calendar year

fields.label: Revised
fields.definition: True when the latest release revised a previously published observation of the series.

fields.label: Revenue growth (YoY)
fields.definition: Revenue of the period over revenue of the same period one year earlier, minus one, in percent. The comparison period is matched on fiscal period, not on calendar date.
fields.derivation: SALES_REV_TURN(t) / SALES_REV_TURN(t − 4 quarters) − 1, ×100

fields.label: Sales per share
fields.definition: Trailing twelve-month revenue divided by the diluted share count of the most recent reported period. The denominator of PX_TO_SALES_RATIO.
fields.derivation: ttm(SALES_REV_TURN) / SHARES_DIL of the latest reported period

fields.label: Revenue
fields.definition: Total net revenue of the period as reported on the income statement, in the reporting currency. Quarterly values are the filed quarter, never a derived difference of year-to-date figures unless the filer reports only year-to-date.

fields.label: Security status
fields.definition: Lifecycle state of the instrument: tradeable, delisted, not yet trading, matured (a bond) or expired (a contract). SECF filters on it; `STATUS=all` lifts the default active filter.

fields.label: Original term
fields.definition: Term of the issue at auction as the Treasury labels it: `4-Week`, `13-Week`, `2-Year`, `10-Year`, `30-Year`. It is the original term, not the remaining life.

fields.label: Security type
fields.definition: Provider security type of the issue as OpenFIGI classifies it: `Common Stock`, `ETP`, `REIT`, `Index`, `Spot`, `US GOVERNMENT`, `Equity Option`.

fields.label: Server time
fields.definition: The server clock at publication of the sys:status frame, in UTC. Clients measure their skew against it.
fields.derivation: clock.now() at publication

fields.label: FX session
fields.definition: Session phase of the FX_USD calendar at SERVER_TIME, over the session_state enum.
fields.derivation: sessionState(FX_USD, SERVER_TIME, false)

fields.label: NYSE session
fields.definition: Session phase of the NYSE calendar (XNYS) at SERVER_TIME, over the session_state enum.
fields.derivation: sessionState(XNYS, SERVER_TIME, true)

fields.label: SIFMA session
fields.definition: Session phase of the SIFMA US bond-market calendar at SERVER_TIME, over the session_state enum.
fields.derivation: sessionState(SIFMA, SERVER_TIME, false)

fields.label: Session
fields.definition: Trading-session phase of the subject at the quote timestamp (FEED-06): pre, open, auction, halted, closed, post or unknown. Halts come from the venue; every other phase from the instrument calendar and the exchange session template.

fields.label: Settlement calendar
fields.definition: Calendar (REF-06) whose holidays the settlement and coupon dates are rolled against — `SIFMA` for US Treasuries.

fields.label: Settlement days
fields.definition: Number of business days between trade and settlement, which is what turns a valuation date into the settlement date used for accrued interest and yield.

fields.label: Sharpe ratio (1 year)
fields.definition: Annualised excess return over annualised volatility on the trailing window: mean daily simple return less the daily risk-free rate, ×252, divided by the sample (n−1) standard deviation ×√252. The Conventions object that fixes ddof, the 252-day year and the risk-free rate is echoed in the engine output.
fields.derivation: (mean(r) × 252 − rf) / (stdev(r, ddof = 1) × sqrt(252))

fields.label: SIC code
fields.definition: Four-digit Standard Industrial Classification code the SEC files the issuer under.

fields.label: SIC description
fields.definition: SEC wording of the SIC code, shown beside it on DES so the number is readable.

fields.label: Sortino ratio (1 year)
fields.definition: Annualised excess return over annualised downside deviation — the same numerator as SHARPE_1Y, but the denominator counts only returns below the target, so upside volatility is not penalised.
fields.derivation: (mean(r) × 252 − rf) / (stdev(min(r − target, 0), ddof = 1) × sqrt(252))

fields.label: Source
fields.definition: Source id of the feed the story came from (licence_registry.source_id), shown as the attribution.

fields.label: Spread to benchmark
fields.definition: Yield of the security less the yield of the on-the-run issue at the nearest standard tenor at or beyond its maturity, in basis points. Unavailable for bills and when the security is itself the benchmark.
fields.derivation: (YLD_YTM_MID − benchmark YLD_YTM_MID) × 100

fields.label: Spread to curve
fields.definition: Yield of the security less the pricing curve’s interpolated par yield at the same time to maturity, in basis points. Positive means the security yields more than the curve.
fields.derivation: (YLD_YTM_MID − CURVE_PAR at the security’s maturity) × 100

fields.label: Spread (formula function)
fields.definition: Not a field: the formula-language function SPREAD(a, b), which subtracts one security’s series from another’s in a computed watchlist column. A bid-ask spread is PX_ASK − PX_BID.

fields.label: Spreads (BTMM section)
fields.definition: Not a field: the SPREADS section token of the BTMM screen, which selects the money-market spread block. Kept only so that the harvested id list resolves.

fields.label: State of incorporation
fields.definition: US state or foreign jurisdiction under whose law the issuer is incorporated.

fields.label: Status
fields.definition: Release status of VALUE: preliminary, final or revised, as the publisher marks the vintage.

fields.label: SVI a (level)
fields.definition: Vertical-shift parameter of the raw SVI slice w(k) = a + b(ρ(k − m) + √((k − m)² + σ²)): the level of total implied variance for the expiry. Stored as vol_surfaces.svi.a.
fields.derivation: least-squares fit of raw SVI total variance to the slice’s mid implied vols

fields.label: SVI b (slope)
fields.definition: Wing-slope parameter of the raw SVI slice: half the sum of the left and right asymptotic slopes of total variance in log-moneyness. Non-negative. Stored as vol_surfaces.svi.b.
fields.derivation: least-squares fit of raw SVI total variance to the slice’s mid implied vols

fields.label: SVI m (shift)
fields.definition: Horizontal-shift parameter of the raw SVI slice: the log-moneyness at which the smile is centred. Stored as vol_surfaces.svi.m.
fields.derivation: least-squares fit of raw SVI total variance to the slice’s mid implied vols

fields.label: SVI fit points
fields.definition: Number of chain points that entered the SVI fit after the quote, moneyness and ivSuspect filters. Fewer than five points returns no fit. Stored as vol_surfaces.svi.n.
fields.derivation: count of strikes surviving the fit filters for the expiry

fields.label: SVI rho (skew)
fields.definition: Rotation parameter of the raw SVI slice, in (−1, 1): the skew of the smile. Negative tilts variance towards low strikes, the usual equity shape. Stored as vol_surfaces.svi.rho.
fields.derivation: least-squares fit of raw SVI total variance to the slice’s mid implied vols

fields.label: SVI fit RMSE
fields.definition: Root-mean-square error of the fitted slice against the observed mid implied volatilities, in volatility points. The quality measure of the fit; stored as vol_surfaces.svi.rmse.
fields.derivation: sqrt(mean((σ_fit(k_i) − σ_obs(k_i))²)) over the fitted points, ×100

fields.label: SVI sigma (curvature)
fields.definition: Curvature parameter of the raw SVI slice: how rounded the smile is at its minimum. Strictly positive. Stored as vol_surfaces.svi.sigma — it is not a volatility.
fields.derivation: least-squares fit of raw SVI total variance to the slice’s mid implied vols

fields.label: Swap accrued
fields.definition: Net interest accrued on the current period to the valuation date: fixed-leg accrual less the compounded floating accrual from the published SOFR fixings, in the trade currency.
fields.derivation: fixed accrual − compounded float accrual on the current period

fields.label: Swap fixed rate
fields.definition: Fixed rate of the swap as traded, in percent. When the trade is struck at market it equals SWAP_PAR_RATE and SWAP_NPV is zero.
fields.derivation: the trade’s fixed rate, or SWAP_PAR_RATE when none was given

fields.label: Swap NPV
fields.definition: Net present value of the swap in the trade currency from the payer’s side: the PV of the floating leg less the PV of the fixed leg, negated for a receiver. Zero at the par rate.
fields.derivation: pvFloat − pvFixed for side = pay; negated for receive

fields.label: Swap par rate
fields.definition: Fixed rate in percent that makes the swap’s net present value zero on the SOFR_OIS build: the market rate for the trade’s start, tenor and schedule.
fields.derivation: pvFloat / Σ accrualFactor_i × CURVE_DF(t_i), ×100

fields.label: Swap PV01
fields.definition: Present value of one basis point on the fixed leg — the annuity of the schedule — in the trade currency. It is the denominator that turns an NPV into a rate difference.
fields.derivation: Σ accrualFactor_i × CURVE_DF(t_i) × notional × 0.0001

fields.label: Target range low
fields.definition: Lower bound of the FOMC federal funds target range in force on the effective date, in percent.

fields.label: Target range high
fields.definition: Upper bound of the FOMC federal funds target range in force on the effective date, in percent.

fields.label: Tenors
fields.definition: Comma-separated tenor codes of the curve pillars in order (1M,3M,6M,1Y,2Y,…) on the c: subject.
fields.derivation: pillar tenors of the curve build

fields.label: Tick
fields.definition: Direction of PX_LAST against the previous composite print: up, down or flat. Derived by the plant from consecutive prints, never taken from a provider; absent on the first print.
fields.derivation: sign(PX_LAST − previous PX_LAST)

fields.label: Total assets (statement line)
fields.definition: The normalised balance-sheet line `TOT_ASSETS` of fin_statements, the row the ratio engine reads. Identical in meaning to BS_TOT_ASSET, which is the dictionary field a screen cites.

fields.label: Total liabilities (statement line)
fields.definition: The normalised balance-sheet line `TOT_LIAB` of fin_statements, the denominator of the leverage ratios. Identical in meaning to BS_TOT_LIAB2.

fields.label: Total return index
fields.definition: Price series rebased to 100 at the start of the requested window with cash dividends reinvested at the ex-date close. The policy that produced it (price, total return, or split-only) is a parameter of the run and is echoed in meta.engines.
fields.derivation: Π (1 + (P_t + D_t)/P_{t−1} − 1) rebased to 100 at the window start

fields.label: Underlying price
fields.definition: Price of the underlying the chain summary was computed against, from the same snapshot as the chain so ATM_IV and the underlying never disagree.
fields.derivation: PX_LAST of the underlying at the chain snapshot

fields.label: Value
fields.definition: Latest observation of the series on the e: subject, in the publisher’s unit. The point-in-time history is ECO_VALUE; this is the live head of it.

fields.label: Average volume (30d)
fields.definition: Arithmetic mean of PX_VOLUME over the last 30 completed sessions. Sessions with no trading are excluded rather than counted as zero.
fields.derivation: mean(PX_VOLUME) over the trailing 30 sessions

fields.label: Realised volatility (30d)
fields.definition: Annualised standard deviation of the last 30 daily simple returns of the split-adjusted close series (adjustment policy `price`), in percent, on a 252-day year. Needs 31 consecutive sessions each carrying a close — a hole in the window makes one “daily” return span two sessions, so the figure is unavailable rather than stretched.
fields.derivation: stdev(P_t/P_{t−1} − 1, n = 30) × sqrt(252) × 100, on the price-adjusted close series (FUNCTIONS_TIER1 §0.6)

fields.label: Realised volatility (90d)
fields.definition: Annualised standard deviation of the last 90 daily simple returns of the split-adjusted close series (adjustment policy `price`), in percent, on a 252-day year — VOL_30D over the longer window. Requires at least 75 observations or it is unavailable.
fields.derivation: stdev(P_t/P_{t−1} − 1, n = 90) × sqrt(252) × 100, on the price-adjusted close series (FUNCTIONS_TIER1 §0.6)

fields.label: VWAP
fields.definition: Volume-weighted average price of the current regular session as the venue publishes it. Absent when no reachable source reports it; it is never computed from bars here.

fields.label: Implied policy rate
fields.definition: Overnight rate in percent that the money-market curve implies will prevail after the FOMC meeting, from the forward rate over the inter-meeting period. Derived from bill and OIS forwards, not from fed funds futures, which this terminal has no source for.
fields.derivation: CURVE_FWD over [meeting, next meeting] on the money-market curve

fields.label: Implied cumulative move
fields.definition: Implied change in the policy rate from the current target midpoint to WIRP_IMPL_RATE, in basis points, cumulative from today to that meeting. Negative means easing.
fields.derivation: (WIRP_IMPL_RATE − (TARGET_FROM + TARGET_TO)/2) × 100

fields.label: Probability of a cut
fields.definition: Probability in percent that the meeting moves the target range down by at least one 25 bp step, from the implied move split across the two bracketing 25 bp outcomes.
fields.derivation: share of WIRP_MOVE_BP allocated to the −25 bp step and below

fields.label: Probability of a hike
fields.definition: Probability in percent that the meeting moves the target range up by at least one 25 bp step, from the implied move split across the two bracketing 25 bp outcomes. The hold, hike and cut probabilities of one meeting sum to 100.
fields.derivation: share of WIRP_MOVE_BP allocated to the +25 bp step and above

fields.label: Probability of no change
fields.definition: Probability in percent that the meeting leaves the target range unchanged: the remainder after WIRP_PROB_HIKE and WIRP_PROB_CUT. A flat curve gives 100.
fields.derivation: 100 − WIRP_PROB_HIKE − WIRP_PROB_CUT

fields.label: Yield value of 1/32
fields.definition: Yield change, in basis points, produced by a price change of one thirty-second of a point — the tick value of the Treasury market expressed in yield terms.

fields.label: Yield to maturity (mid)
fields.definition: Annualised yield that discounts the remaining cash flows of the bond to its mid dirty price, on the issue’s own day-count and coupon frequency. Semi-annual bond-equivalent for US Treasury notes and bonds; discount-to-BEY conversion for bills.
fields.derivation: solve price(y) = PX_DIRTY_MID by Newton on the issue day-count (ACT/ACT for UST)

fields.label: Z-spread
fields.definition: Constant spread in basis points added to every zero rate of the pricing curve that makes the discounted cash flows equal PX_DIRTY_MID. Unlike SPRD_TO_CRV it uses the whole curve rather than one interpolated point, so it is zero for a bond priced off the curve.
fields.derivation: Brent solve of Σ cf_t · df(t, z) = PX_DIRTY_MID over ±2000 bp
